name: Kigali Keys
tagline: A furnished home in Kigali — with the keys to a car.
summary: Whole 2-bedroom duplex in a gated Kigali neighbourhood. Sleeps 4.
description:
This is the whole upper-and-lower duplex, not a room in a shared house. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a full kitchen. Fast fibre runs throughout at around 100 Mbps, backed up by a second connection and a power inverter for the occasional cut, and the dining table works well as a desk for anyone working from Kigali.

It sits inside a gated compound in Rebero, a quiet residential hill about 12 minutes from the CBD and 20 from the airport. There is 24-hour security on the gate, private parking, and the Kia Sorento is kept on the premises.

The home is set up for stays of a week or more: a weekly linen change is included, the kitchen is properly equipped, and there is room to work without sitting on the bed.
neighbourhoodText: Quiet, gated, upmarket residential. About 12 minutes from the CBD and a short drive to two supermarkets. Walkable within the compound and the immediate street; most errands need a car or a moto.

Give the booking name to the security team at the compound gate.
Collect the keys from the lockbox by the front door and let yourself in.
Message the host to confirm you are settled; anything you need is in the welcome note on the table.
checkIn.publicPreview: Self check-in from 14:00 with a lockbox. The exact address is shared after your booking is approved.

houseRulesSummary: Maximum 4 guests — the number on the booking
arrivalGuide:
Airport transfer: a metered taxi from Kigali International to Rebero is about USD 20–25 and takes 20 minutes; the host can arrange a fixed-price pickup for USD 25 if you send a flight number.

Connectivity: buy an Airtel or MTN SIM at the airport (bring your passport) for a few dollars with generous data, or use an eSIM booked before you fly.

Money: the currency is the Rwandan franc. Cards work in supermarkets and hotels; markets and motos are cash. Mobile money (MoMo) is everywhere.

Practical: plugs are UK-style Type G, 230V. Kigali is safe to walk in, including at night on the main roads; the compound is gated with 24-hour security.
gettingAroundWithoutCar: Moto-taxis are the quickest way around the city — flag one down or use the Move or YegoMoto apps; a typical hop across town is RWF 1,000–2,000. Ride-hail cars (Move) are available for longer trips or when it rains. For weekend trips without the Sorento you would need a driver or an intercity bus from Nyabugogo.

faq.question: How fast is the wifi, really?
faq.answer: Fibre, around 100 Mbps down and 40 up on a normal day, with a second connection that fails over automatically. Video calls are not a problem.

faq.question: Is there a proper place to work?
faq.answer: The internet is genuinely fast — fibre at around 100 Mbps with a backup line — and the dining table works well as a desk. A dedicated desk is being added; for now there is no separate study.

faq.question: How does laundry work?
faq.answer: There is a washing machine in the unit. Linens and towels are changed once a week.

faq.question: Are pets allowed?
faq.answer: Not at this time, so the home stays allergen-free for future guests.

faq.question: Can children stay?
faq.answer: Yes. The maximum is 4 guests total including children. A travel cot is available on request.

faq.question: Can we have extra guests over?
faq.answer: Day visitors are fine within reason; overnight guests beyond the number on the booking are not, and there are no parties or events.

faq.question: Where do we park?
faq.answer: Inside the gated compound, in a private space. The Kia Sorento has its own spot.

faq.question: How is payment handled?
faq.answer: No payment is taken on this website. When the host approves your request, the approval email sets out the amount and how to pay — usually a bank transfer to confirm and the balance on arrival. The car is paid on site.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: It is set out in full on the cancellation policy page and summarised in the booking flow. You accept it when you submit a request.

faq.question: Do you offer long-stay discounts?
faq.answer: For stays of a month or more, mention it in your message and the host will factor it into the final amount at approval.

pricing.paymentNote: No payment is taken on this site. The host confirms the final amount and payment method when approving your request.
pricing.carNote: The Kia Sorento is USD 45/day, arranged with your booking and paid on site.
